jobs.occupation: Senior Partnership Advisor, Foundations & Private Sector (Re-advertisement)
jobs.description:
The overall purpose of Danish Red Cross’ (DRC) international engagement is to increase and strengthen humanitarian impact, inspire and act for human dignity, and enhance resilience and social cohesion in contexts of poverty, conflict and disaster.

The Global Partnership unit leads the coordination and strategic direction of the Danish Red Cross’ international partnerships, external and within the Red Cross and Red Crescent movement. The Unit is responsible for global resource mobilization efforts and initiatives and provides support to countries and regions. The Unit hosts the Danish Red Cross’ core donor specialization knowledge and capacity on compliance and strategies. Furthermore, the unit supports and quality assures proposals to core donors.

The position

As part of the Movement relations and private partnerships team (MOPS), the Partnership Advisor will drive Danish Red Cross’ strategic engagement with Danish and international foundations and private sector actors, with the objective of growing and diversifying non-institutional funding and strategic partnerships. The role combines new partnership development with strategic management and growth of high-value, multi-year partnerships. It focuses on senior-level relationship building, development of innovative partnership models, negotiation of multi-year agreements, and strong partnership stewardship across the full lifecycle. The Advisor will position DRC as a preferred humanitarian partner among Danish businesses, corporate foundations, family foundations, and selected international private sector actors through collaboration within the Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement.

Main responsibilities:

• Develop and implement a multi-year strategy for Danish and international private sector and foundation engagement aligned with DRC’s international priorities.

• Build and convert a qualified pipeline of high-value partnership opportunities, with clear income and partnership-growth ambitions.

• Lead the strategic management of one or more high-value, multi-year foundation partnerships, including relationship management, governance, internal coordination, delivery oversight and identification of opportunities for growth.

• Ensure strong partnership stewardship throughout the grant lifecycle, working closely with programme, finance and operational colleagues to support delivery, reporting, compliance and proactive management of risks and partner expectations.

• Develop partnership models beyond traditional grant funding, including strategic co-creation and multi-stakeholder alliances.

• Support country and regional teams to identify, shape and pursue high-potential private sector and foundation partnerships.

• Work closely with Business Development Advisors, Fundraising, and Operations to align private sector engagement with programming priorities.

• Represent DRC in relevant private sector and foundation networks and relevant Movement platforms related to private sector engagement.

We expect you to have the following qualifications:

• A master’s degree or MBA in Business, International Affairs, International Development or related

• Significant experience (7-10 years) in business development, resource mobilization, partnership development, preferably in the humanitarian or non-profit sector

• Demonstrated success in securing high-value, multi-year private sector or foundation partnerships

• Demonstrated experience managing complex, high-value, multi-year and/or multi-stakeholder partnerships including stakeholder engagement, negotiation, renewal and growth

• Strong established network in Denmark and ideally internationally

• Solid understanding of private sector CSR strategies, corporate foundations, and philanthropic trends

• Strong strategic account-management skills, including experience balancing partner expectations with organisational priorities and operational realities

• Experience coordinating complex partnerships across multiple internal teams, technical areas and geographies

• Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, Danish is an advantage

As a person you have the following competences:

• High level of strategic thinking and diplomatic and political judgement

• Ability to lead processes and engage people across functions and geographies

• Results-oriented and entrepreneurial mindset and ability to turn opportunities into concrete action.

• Collaborative team player with the ability to build trust and work in a multicultural environment

We offer

A full-time position of 37 working hours per week in an inspiring workplace. You will have the opportunity to work in a diversified motivated team of donor experts and be part of Danish Red Cross’ large global humanitarian action. You will refer to the Head of Global Partnership in Copenhagen.

The position is based in Copenhagen with potential 4-8-week travel. Salary and employment conditions will comply with Danish Red Cross’s collective bargain agreement with AC.

Application and further information

We look forward to receiving your application via the Red Cross home page www.rodekors.dk/job

In case you have questions to the position please contact Head of Global Partnerships, Marie-Chantal Legendre Dahl mcd@rodekors.dk or Team coordinator Vivian Pucher vipuc@rodekors.dk

Application deadline is 20th November 2026; Interviews will take place soon thereafter. The expected date of commencement is as soon as possible, preferably no later than January 1st.

_

Red Cross

Join us. Together we can make a world of difference. The Red Cross is always present. We are the largest humanitarian organisation in the world and for 150 years we have helped alleviate people through wars and disasters, diseases and loneliness. Most countries have signed an agreement which gives the Red Cross Red Crescent Movement a unique position and mandate to provide aid regardless of nationality, race or political views. We currently count 11 million volunteers in 191 countries. We are part of your local community no matter where you live. When disaster strikes, we are there._

jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**R&D Quality encompasses four teams GCLP/GLP Quality, PV Quality, Audit Calibration, Quality and GCP Quality. R&D Quality has a large range of stakeholders, and we have an important role in delivering our 2030 vision to transform the future of cancer treatment.

In the role as AD GCP Inspection Office you will be driving day-to-day GCP Quality activities including audit together with a dedicated and highly skilled team. Furthermore, you will be taking up the role as GCP Inspection QA lead.

The role requires profound understanding of how the GCP requirements are applied into practice, especially with focus on the European requirements and interpretation of ICH GCP R3 and Computerized Systems in Clinical Trials.

The role includes hands on GCP Quality activities such as support to our many stakeholders as well as performing audits alone or together with own team members or with support from neighbouring teams. You become a key member of the R&D Quality leadership team that together drives people engagement, setting strategies and ensuring R&D Quality deliverables.

The role requires strong collaboration capabilities in an international setting across various QA departments as well across the company with target stakeholders such as Clinical Trial Operations, Clinical Data, Integration & Reporting, Digital Development, Medical, GDS&PV, and Regulatory Affairs.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Reporting to Director and Team Lead Inspection Office R&D Quality

• It will ensure GCP inspection readiness across cross functional clinical -study team.

• The role oversees end-of-end inspection planning and execution including logistics and stakeholder coordination.

• Lead and oversee GCP inspection readiness/preparation activities and serve as an inspection lead for regulatory health authority inspection including but not limited to US FDA, MHRA, EMA, CFDI, PMDA etc.

• Ensure Veeva records are updated for inspection records or related records.

• Demonstrate ability to solve complex problems requiring in-depth evaluation of various factors.

• Fulfill inspection commitments and respond to the inspection and carry out post inspection activities.

• Maintain a central repository of global inspection status and updates

• Meticulous attention to detail, excellent review skills and ability to independently manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

• Support/manage site inspection in collaboration with GCP Quality.

• Lead and facilitate post-inspection lessons learned session to trends, share best practices and drive sustainable process improvements.

**

• MS, or BS or similar in Natural Science

• 10+ years of experience in a GCP Quality function or similar

• Deep expertise in GCP processes and the EMA, PMDA and FDA requirements.

• Demonstrated leadership in regulatory inspections and health authority interactions.

• Considered to be a Domain Expert within GCP by peers with a strong interest and ability to educate others

• Experience as Lead Auditor within GCP is an advantage

Job title: Senior Research Scientist – Discovery Pharmacology

Department: Global Research

Location: Måløv, Denmark

Your impact begins here

As Senior Research Scientist – Discovery Pharmacology, you will help build a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research that generates and validates therapeutic concepts in cardiometabolic disease and healthspan. You will combine hands-on rodent pharmacology with original scientific thinking, shaping research questions and turning emerging biology into opportunities for drug discovery. Your work will bring new projects into the early discovery pipeline, because lasting health starts with the science we build today.

What you will bring

You hold a PhD in pharmacology, physiology, neuroscience or a related discipline, or bring equivalent relevant research experience. You also bring:

• At least two years of relevant post-PhD experience with scientific innovation, or equivalent scientific contributions.

• Hands-on experience in rodent pharmacology.

• Strong skills in experimental design, quantitative analysis and interpretation of complex biological data.

• Scientific depth in metabolic physiology, neuroscience, in vitro pharmacology, or a related area.

• Original scientific thinking, intellectual curiosity and the ability to turn ideas into testable hypotheses.

• A collaborative approach and the ability to work independently while contributing to shared research goals.

• Clear scientific communication in written and spoken English.

Useful, but not essential:

Experience in metabolic phenotyping, advanced behavioural assays, rodent surgery, modern neuroscience methods, in vitro or ex vivo approaches, or developing novel experimental technologies. We welcome complementary profiles – you are not expected to bring expertise in every method or scientific area.

What you will do

You will contribute to both the scientific direction and hands-on experimental work of the team. Your responsibilities will include:

• Generate hypotheses and propose new therapeutic concepts grounded in biological understanding.

• Design, conduct, analyse and interpret mouse and rat pharmacology studies to investigate efficacy, mechanism of action and physiological responses.

• Develop experimental models and introduce methodologies that enable us to address challenging scientific questions.

• Connect in vivo findings with relevant in vitro and ex vivo experiments.

• Integrate evidence into recommendations on how emerging concepts should advance, change direction or be discontinued.

• Document and communicate findings, sharing scientific insights across disciplines and project teams.

• Contribute to rigorous, reproducible experimental practice and high standards of animal welfare.

All scientists are expected to contribute directly to experimental work alongside laboratory technicians and fellow scientists.

Who you will work with

You will join a new interdisciplinary team in Global Research within Research & Development, combining expertise in physiology, pharmacology, neuroscience and molecular innovation. jobs.description:
Enterprise Sales Development Representative — Italian Speaking, South Pod EMEAHelp us create qualified enterprise pipeline that protects the world's factory floors

Start date: January 1, 2027

At Secomea, our Sales Development team plays a critical role in creating and developing new business opportunities across manufacturers, machine builders and industrial organizations.

As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative for our South Pod, with a focus on Italy, you'll work closely with Territory Managers and the wider commercial team to identify the right accounts, engage relevant stakeholders and develop opportunities into qualified enterprise pipeline.

Your primary focus will be supporting our growth across Italy and the Southern European markets.

This is not simply an appointment-setting role. We want our SDRs to understand the businesses they target, recognize relevant market and customer signals, and have credible conversations with prospects.

You'll use modern sales technology and AI to make research, preparation and personalization more effective—giving you more time to focus on developing business and engaging customers.

What you'll do

• 
Generate qualified pipeline across named enterprise accounts within the Southern Europe territory

• 
Research and prioritize target accounts based on fit, business signals and relevant triggers

• 
Develop outbound, inbound and partner-sourced opportunities

• 
Engage prospects through calls, email, LinkedIn and other relevant channels

• 
Build relationships across multiple stakeholders, including OT, Security, Operations, IT and business leaders

• 
Run initial discovery to understand business challenges, priorities, timing and potential opportunities

• 
Work strategically with Territory Managers on target accounts and territory priorities

• 
Collaborate with Partner Managers, Marketing and Pre-Sales to develop opportunities

• 
Create high-quality Sales Accepted Opportunities and ensure a strong handover to the Territory Manager

• 
Use AI and sales technology to support account research, preparation and relevant outreach

• 
Maintain accurate account, activity and opportunity information in Salesforce

What we're looking for

Commercial curiosity

You're interested in understanding how companies operate, what challenges they're facing and where there may be an opportunity to create value.

You don't just ask, "Who can I book a meeting with?" You want to understand why this company, why this person and why now.

Strong communication

You're comfortable starting conversations with new people, whether that's over the phone, email, LinkedIn or in a meeting.

You can communicate clearly, ask good questions and adapt your approach depending on who you're speaking with.

Fluent, professional-level Italian and English, both written and spoken, is required for this role, as you'll be prospecting, conducting discovery and communicating with senior stakeholders across the Italy and Southern European markets.

Dutch language skills are a strong advantage, but not required.

Account-based thinking

You understand—or want to learn—how enterprise sales differs from high-volume prospecting.

You're comfortable researching accounts, identifying multiple relevant stakeholders and developing different ways into an organization rather than relying on a single contact.

Business acumen

You're interested in learning about manufacturing, industrial operations and cybersecurity and can connect technology to business outcomes such as uptime, productivity, service efficiency, risk and compliance.

AI & digital fluency

You're comfortable using modern technology to work smarter.

Experience with generative AI, sales intelligence or prospecting tools is an advantage, but you don't need to be an AI expert. What's more important is curiosity, good judgment and the willingness to learn how these tools can improve your research and sales effectiveness.

Drive and discipline

You're proactive, resilient and comfortable taking ownership of your territory and pipeline.

At the same time, you understand that enterprise sales requires discipline: following up, keeping CRM data accurate, documenting what you've learned and consistently delivering on commitments.

How we measure success

Success in this role is about creating quality pipeline—not simply generating activity.

You'll be measured on areas including:

• 
Qualified opportunities created

• 
Pipeline generated

• 
Qualified meetings booked and held

• 
Quality and conversion of opportunities

• 
Development of target enterprise accounts

• 
Collaboration with Territory Managers and partners

• 
Consistent use of our sales processes and tools

What success looks like at Secomea

Our strongest Enterprise SDRs are account-first, curious and commercially minded.

They research before they reach out. They look for real reasons to engage. They build relationships across an organization rather than relying on one contact. They use technology intelligently, but know that great conversations and human judgment ultimately create opportunities.

Most importantly, they see themselves as business developers—not appointment setters.

If you're excited about developing your enterprise sales career while working at the intersection of industrial technology, cybersecurity and modern sales, we'd like to hear from you.

jobs.description:
The Job

We are looking for Warehouse Operators to join AGC Biologics' GMP Warehouse in Søborg. You will become part of our Picking team, which plays a vital role in supporting the production of life-saving medicines.

At AGC Biologics, we work with the purpose of "Bringing purpose to life", and your role will help support the production of life-saving medicines for patients around the world.

At AGC Biologics, you will handle materials and products that are of great value and play a critical role in pharmaceutical production. Therefore, quality, accuracy, and accountability are essential in the daily work.

You can expect an active workday with plenty of walking, structured routines, and close collaboration with colleagues across warehouse and production departments. At the same time, you will become part of an international workplace with employees from many different cultures and nationalities, where positivity, respect, and teamwork are a natural part of everyday life.

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Picking and packing materials and goods

• 
Scanning and registering goods in warehouse management systems

• 
Receiving goods from external warehouses and logistics partners

• 
Storing and placing goods in designated warehouse locations

• 
Inventory counting and quality control

• 
Processing inventory transactions and warehouse documentation

• 
Forklift operation and internal transport of materials

• 
Cleaning and maintaining general warehouse order to support GMP requirements

• 
Various ad hoc tasks in the daily operation

This is a physically demanding warehouse position where heavy lifting may occur, so it is important that you enjoy staying active throughout the workday.

What We Offer

• 
A workplace with strong team spirit, a positive atmosphere, and a culture where colleagues support one another

• 
Thorough training in warehouse processes and GMP requirements

• 
The opportunity to work in an international company with an important purpose

• 
Great colleagues who collaborate and succeed together

• 
A canteen scheme as well as access to fruit, coffee, and excellent facilities

Your Profile

We imagine that you:

• 
Have experience from warehouse operations, preferably around 2 years or more

• 
Thrive in an active and physically demanding work environment

• 
Are comfortable working with warehouse systems, scanners, and documentation

• 
Work in a structured manner and pay attention to quality and details

• 
Are reliable, punctual, and take responsibility for your tasks

• 
Understand the importance of handling products and materials correctly

• 
Have a positive attitude and contribute to strong teamwork

• 
Can read and understand English, as training materials and procedures are provided in English

Experience from the pharmaceutical, biotech, GMP, or other quality-regulated industries is an advantage, but not a requirement. You will receive training in the relevant processes.

A forklift certificate is a strong advantage and will be required for some functions.

A clean criminal record must be presented as part of the hiring process.

Practical Information

Please note that your first week will include onboarding, certifications, and training. A significant part of the introduction is conducted through written training materials and procedures in English, so it is important that you are comfortable working with English documentation.

Working hours are either:

• 
Day shift: 07:00 - 15:00 / 08:00 - 16:00

• 
Evening shift: 14:00 - 22:00

The position is Monday to Friday.

This is a full-time temporary position running until December 31, 2026, with an immediate start. For the right candidates, there may be opportunities for further extension and potential permanent employment.

Salary is based on the applicable collective agreement and follows AGC Biologics' salary framework.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and look forward to hearing from you.

The company

AGC Biologics (AGC) is a global Contract Development Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) with bio-manufacturing facilities in Europe, Japan, Italy and the USA. The company provides a comprehensive range of commercial and clinical cGMP biologics manufacturing services, from DNA to active pharmaceutical ingredient (API). The company’s team and approach are tailored to each of its client’s needs, whether turnkey manufacturing or sophisticated, stand-alone analytical, formulation and stability services.

Join us and help shape PtX (Power-to-X) and BtX (Bio-to-X) projects on a global scale, working with an experienced team on the solutions of the future.

At Blue Power Partners, we are a global consultancy and project development company dedicated to delivering renewable energy solutions that support sustainable change. Our core expertise is conceptual design and economic modeling of entire complexes, including wind and solar farms, power sourcing, and downstream PtX and BtX facilities.

We work closely with our clients, who include one of the world’s largest fund managers in greenfield renewable energy.

**About the job

**We are looking for an experienced Senior Process Engineer to contribute to the development of PtX and BtX facilities worldwide. You will join a team of skilled specialists in a role with a wide variety of tasks. The key deliverables are due diligence, feasibility analysis, and initial conceptual design.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Leading process development, including feasibility studies and pre-FEED, and sharing your process expertise as a technical advisor

• Working with our modeling team on techno-economic optimization by providing technical and economic input

• Taking part in technical classification meetings, exhibit reviews, and negotiations

• Supporting proposals, tender processes, safety assessments, and plant commissioning

• Helping develop in-house tools, such as techno-economic calculation models, to support concept design and benchmarking of PtX and BtX projects

• Coordinating across project disciplines and stakeholders

• Managing third-party verification

• Contributing to knowledge sharing and smooth project delivery

You will work from our office in Copenhagen (Tromsøgade 2, Nordhavn) or Aalborg HQ (John F. Kennedys Plads 43). Because we work globally, the role sometimes calls for flexibility, and we offer the same in return.

**About you

**You are curious and enjoy learning. You like working in a structured, thoughtful way, and you thrive in an international, multicultural environment where adaptability and teamwork matter.

We are looking for someone who brings:

• An MSc in chemical engineering or another relevant engineering field

• Around 10 years of experience with chemical processes

• Strong process experience, including PFDs, process modeling tools (e.g., Aspen HYSYS, DWSIM), equipment design, P&IDs, and process safety

• A solid understanding of thermodynamics, reaction engineering, fluid flow, heat transfer, and mass transfer

• Hands-on experience with one or more PtX or BtX production processes, such as electrolysis, steam methane reforming (SMR), Haber-Bosch, methanol synthesis, methanation, synthesis of higher hydrocarbons (SAF), refinery processes, biomass processing, carbon capture, or CO2 sequestration

• Good collaboration and organizational skills

• Fluent written and spoken English

**Contact

**For more information about the position, please contact Anne Krog Jensen, Head of PtX & Molecules, at akj@bluepp.dk.

To apply, upload your resume through our recruitment system via the “Apply” link. We don’t accept applications by email.

**Why join Blue Power Partners?

**At Blue Power Partners, we value belonging, purpose, and diverse perspectives, and we believe they contribute to our innovation and long-term success. Our organization is built on trust, entrepreneurship, and balance. You will join a focused team working on specialized technical projects, where you can grow your expertise in PtX and BtX. Joining BPP means becoming part of a consultancy that is contributing to the energy transition, with strong technical roots and an international scope.
